caption: One poll of the worked example: the client sends a 300-byte GET for device 17 and gets back a 500-byte reading, so 300 + 500 = 800 bytes per poll. Notice the client never talks to the device directly — the API server does the reading for it.

spec.aria: A sequence diagram of one request-response poll: the client sends a 300-byte GET for device 17 to the API server, the server reads the sensor and gets 31.5 degrees Celsius back, then returns 200 OK with a 500-byte body to the client.
